definition_zh: 孤峰；平顶山（四周陡峭、顶部平坦的小山）
definition_en: an isolated hill with steep sides and a flat top, common in the western United States
core_image: 荒原上一座拔地而起的方桌形小山
scene: 美国西部的荒原上，一座方桌似的小山立在红土之中。The highway bent around the flat-topped butte.
sceneCN: 这里 butte 是「孤峰、平顶山」（第 1 个义项：顶平壁陡的孤立小山）；句意是公路绕着这座平顶山拐了个弯。

pos.zh: 孤峰；平顶山；陡壁平顶小山

derivatives.zh: 近义词，源自西班牙语，义为「台地，方山」
近义词，源自法语，义为「高原」
相关地貌词，义为「陡崖，断崖」

senses.title: An isolated flat-topped hill
senses.definition: a small, steep-sided hill with a flat top, standing alone in flat country
senses.definitionCN: 孤立于平地、四壁陡峭、顶部平坦的小山
senses.example: Erosion left the butte standing alone on the plain.
senses.exampleCN: 侵蚀作用使孤峰独自矗立在平原上。
senses.why: The word is a French geographical term adopted for the landforms of the American West.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本是法语地理术语，被借来命名美国西部的地貌。

senses.title: A landmark or place name built on the landform
senses.titleCN: 地名中的孤峰（专名成分）
senses.definition: used in the names of towns and natural features, as in Butte, Montana, or Elephant Butte
senses.definitionCN: 用于城镇和自然地名中，如蒙大拿州的比尤特、象峰（Elephant Butte）
senses.example: The mining city of Butte grew rich on copper dug beneath the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 矿业城市比尤特靠山下挖出的铜矿致富。
senses.why: A striking landform naturally becomes a place name.
senses.whyCN: 醒目的地貌自然转为地名。

senses.title: A prominent isolated feature by analogy
senses.definition: anything that stands isolated and conspicuous like such a hill, used figuratively or in other sciences
senses.definitionCN: 借指如孤峰般孤立而醒目之物，用于比喻或其他学科
senses.example: On the ocean floor, geologists mapped a volcanic butte rising from the abyssal plain.
senses.exampleCN: 在洋底，地质学家测绘出深海平原上耸立的一座火山孤丘。
senses.why: The image of an isolated rising transfers to any lonely, prominent form.
senses.whyCN: 「孤立隆起」的意象可转用于任何孤绝醒目的形态。

intro.en: Butte is the French word for a small hill or mound, borrowed unchanged into English.
intro.cn: butte 是法语中指小丘、土墩的词，原样借入英语。

items.en: the deeper root of Old French butte is not established; some connect it to words for a mark or target.
items.cn: 古法语 butte 更深的词根未获确证；有说法把它与表示「标记、靶」的词相联系，属假说。

items.en: butte meant a mound or hillock, of uncertain further origin.
items.cn: 古法语 butte 意为土墩、小丘。

items.en: French surveyors used butte for any isolated rising of the ground.
items.cn: 法国测绘者用 butte 指任何孤立的地面隆起。

items.en: explorers of the American West adopted the word for the flat-topped hills of the plains.
items.cn: 十九世纪美国西部探险者借这个词指平原上的平顶山。

items.en: butte now names a specific landform, smaller than a mesa.
items.cn: 如今 butte 指特定地貌，比 mesa（方山）略小。

note.en: The look-alike group warns against the shorter word butt; the near-meaning group lists related landforms.
note.cn: 形近组提醒与更短的 butt 区分；近义组是相关地貌词。

entries.definition: to strike with the head; a cigarette end
entries.definitionCN: 顶撞；烟蒂，只是拼写相近，词源无关
美人、好东西（beauty 的口语缩略），发音相同，词源无关

entries.definition: an extensive area of flat highland
a single massive stone or hill
a long steep slope at a plateau edge
entries.definitionCN: 陡崖，高原边缘的长陡坡
露头，裸露于地表的岩石

normalIntro.en: The French hill word ends in a silent e, unlike its verb cousin butt.
normalIntro.cn: 这个法语山丘词末尾有不发音的 e，区别于动词 butt。

normal.en: A butte is smaller than a mesa.
Buttes are typical of the American West.
normal.cn: 孤峰是美国西部的典型地貌。

normal.en: The silent e lengthens the vowel: boot.
normal.cn: 不发音的 e 拉长元音，读如 boot。

normal.en: Butte and butt are unrelated despite the look.
normal.cn: butte 与 butt 虽形近，词源无关。

abstract.en: See a giant table of red stone rising from the prairie grass.
abstract.cn: 看草原上耸起一张红石巨桌。

abstract.en: Feel the wind swirl around the butte's steep sides.
abstract.cn: 感受风绕着孤峰陡壁打旋。

abstract.en: Picture a hawk circling the flat top at dawn.
abstract.cn: 想象黎明时一只鹰在平顶上空盘旋。

examples.en: The climbers camped at the foot of the butte.
examples.cn: 登山者在孤峰脚下扎营。

examples.en: Sunset turned the sandstone butte deep orange.
examples.cn: 落日把砂岩孤峰染成深橙色。

examples.en: From the top of the butte the prairie stretched to the horizon.
examples.cn: 从孤峰顶上望去，草原一直延伸到天边。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「标特」——荒原上孤峰像一座「标」志性的「特」色山。

root: butte 为法语借词，古法语 butte 意为土墩、小丘，更早来源不确定；十九世纪美国西部探险者用它命名平原上的平顶孤山，从此成为固定地貌术语。

sensesIntro.en: A single geographic sense: the lone flat-topped hill of dry western plains.
sensesIntro.cn: 单一地理义项：干旱西部平原上孤立的平顶小山。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone table rising alone from flat ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：平地上孤然耸立的一张石桌。

branches.en: a highway bending around the butte
climbers at the foot of the butte
a hawk over the flat top
butte against mesa, small against large

intro.en: Butte is a borrowed noun with no English affixes; its family is a set of French landform words.
intro.cn: butte 是无英语词缀的借入名词；其词族是一组法语地貌词。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root is established; the word's deeper origin is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 无确证的拉丁词根；更早词源不确定。
